desc: Derive the matching condition: answer Yes iff there exists S >= M with m(S) = sum_a min(cntA[a], cntB[S-a]) >= L = p + q - N; L <= 1 is trivially Yes.
Implement the exact candidate-filtered solver and fix top_values to return all distinct values appearing among the top k elements.
Remove the obsolete FILTER_LIMIT/packed-sort fallback; the candidate product is at most about 1e6 for N <= 2000, so the exact scan is always used.
Verify samples, regression cases, edge cases, and worst-case complexity (at most about 4e6 pair iterations and at most about 1e6 candidate dict entries).
